_description: ISCA'27 P21 baseline: first-touch with real migration cost on m3p (M3+): a page migrates to the GPM of its first vector access (if not already its home) through the pm fault path (UVM-style batch 256, software 5 us, shootdown 1 us, drain, 4 KB copy over the mesh; the faulting access waits; other GPMs use the old home or wait per pm semantics), then stays (max 1 migration, later accesses never fault).
